messages:
Ravi: starting HorizonBank POC thread. requirements: streaming SDK with function/tool calls, strict EU data residency, customer-managed KMS, and guidance on quantized models + cost delta. any immediate blockers?
Nina: EU-only = Private or Dedicated + strict routing. Legal will need KMS key lifecycle diagram and a statement about no plaintext key exposure.
Hugo: integration notes: recommend ephemeral tokens for websocket sessions; reduces long-lived credential risk. sample snippet:

```
# websocket init (curl upgrade)
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer ${EPHEMERAL_TOKEN}" \
  -H "X-Region: eu-west-1" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=redwood-4b-quant
```
Also advise enabling adaptive_batching and request-level `function_call` fallback for schema recovery.
Ops-Bot: flagged infra: EU-private requires VPC peering and optional on-prem connector. open ticket INF-824.
Finance: rough delta: quantized model reduces token cost ~2.1x in many workloads but expect quality drift; committed dedicated pricing draft needs qps + tokens/day.
Legal: confirm we can provide KMS key-wrap diagram and redacted SOC2 extracts for review. I'll start the intake.
SE-Maya: i'll run a small bench: fp16 vs 8-bit quant on a 200-sample prompt set once we have test prompts. please send sample prompts and target correctness threshold.
Ravi: ok action items: Finance = draft quote, SE-Maya = bench plan, Nina = infra/legal loop, Hugo = sample SDK snippets + schema example. i'll book a 30m call after bench results. ping here with updates. :rocket:
